title: stack bead and sprint-family pour: stack-bead.json.j2, pour metadata, pydantic model per bead kind, validate-plan

description:
## Goal
The stack bead `<prefix>-phase-<x>.stack` exists for every phase as the ledger and the lock of its stack, poured with the phase root and required by `validate-plan`; the pour writes branch, worktree, pr_target and difficulty onto every bead of a sprint family; a pydantic model per bead kind with one validation over every bead of the phase fails the pour on any missing value. Governing text: `docs/requirements/sanity-stack.md` 1 and 2, `team-lead.md` 13, 43, atm-bd-orchestration #340 (Rand: "so due to pour and validate, the info MUST be in the bead"). Anchors: ANC-063, ANC-067.

## Deliverables
1. `templates/stack-bead.json.j2` (skills/atm-beads): one bead per stack, id `<prefix>-phase-<x>.stack`, `issue_type` task, child of the phase root, labels `phase-<x>`, `stage:stack`, metadata `trunk` (the root's `integration_branch`), `stack_number` (null until the first link) and `layers` (empty list). `resources/planning.md` lists it beside `plan-root.json.j2` as rendered with the root into the plan JSONL; it is never created by hand (team-lead 13).
2. Layer record: each `layers` entry is `{branch, pr, head, base, linked}`; the last entry is the top; `layers` is the only record of layer order (ANC-067). `bead_schema.py` carries the `StackBead` model with `trunk`, `layers` and the entry model; the claim and the compare-and-set release are plain `bd` commands documented in `resources/orchestrating.md` ("Stack bead": `bd update <stack bead> --claim`; release `bd update <stack bead> --if-assignee "$ATM_IDENTITY" --status open --assignee ""`; a claim older than 900 s with no event is abandoned and reclaimed with `bd reclaim`), used by sanity-stack (bj-3) and the lead.
3. `validate-plan`: problem 6, the stack bead is missing, is not a child of the root, or its `metadata.trunk` differs from the root's `integration_branch`; `--file` mode accepts the rendered stack bead in the file.
4. Pour metadata (#340 item 1): `bead-groups` writes `branch`, `worktree`, `pr_target` and `difficulty` from the sprint container onto the group's sanity and qa beads; `dev-sanity-assignment.json.j2` and `qa-bead.json.j2` take them as required variables. Beads poured for a blocking finding (the fix group) carry the same four keys from the layer cut (#340 item 2); `assignment-gates.py` is not edited here (its readers already expect the keys on the bead).
5. One model per bead kind (#340 item 3): sprint container, dev, sanity, qa (with `checked_bead` and the round), gate, finding, fix, stack, and the sanity and qa children of a finding or fix; each names its required metadata keys; `extra="allow"` stays. `bead_schema.py validate --phase <x>` walks every bead under the phase epic (`bd list -l phase-<x> -n 0 --json`, never `--all`), picks the model from the `stage:*` label, and exits non-zero naming each bead and missing key (#340 item 4). `bead-groups` runs it at the end of every pour and fails the pour on a problem. `schemas/*.schema.json` re-exported.
6. `templates/dev-fix.xml.j2` and `examples/dev-fix-vars.json` deleted; `phase-config init` no longer writes `dev_fix` and `validate-plan`/`plan_contract.py` accept a phase file without it (a sanity FAIL reopens the bead in place on the same task; nothing re-assigns a dev after a FAIL: task-close-hook.md 15). Existing phase files that still carry `dev_fix` stay valid.
7. Tests: `bead_schema.py` model per kind with fixtures mirroring live ids (`atm-bi-7`, `atm-bi-7.group-sanity`, `atm-phase-bi.15-sanity`, `atm-phase-bi.18-qa`, a stack bead), the validate walk, `validate-plan` problem 6 and `--file` with the stack bead, `bead-groups` writing the four keys onto sanity and qa beads and failing the pour on a model error.

## Required Work
- The phase-bi live beads are the fixture source: copy their JSON shapes into the tests, do not invent fields.
- `bead-groups` keeps its dry-run (`--validate`) path; the end-of-pour validation runs in both modes.

## This Sprint Does Not Close
- Reading `metadata.layers` in the close hook (bj-1) and writing it under the claim (bj-3, sanity-stack): this sprint ships the schema, the pour and the validation only.
- The console dispatch reading the poured keys (atm-core atm-phase-bi.18, phase-bi).
design:
## Public Contract
`templates/stack-bead.json.j2`:
```json
{"id": "<prefix>-phase-<x>.stack", "title": "phase-<x>: stack", "issue_type": "task", "status": "open",
 "labels": ["phase-<x>", "stage:stack"],
 "dependencies": [{"issue_id": "<prefix>-phase-<x>.stack", "depends_on_id": "<prefix>-phase-<x>", "type": "parent-child"}],
 "metadata": {"phase": "<x>", "trunk": "integrate/phase-<x>", "stack_number": null, "layers": []}}
```
`bead_schema.py`:
```python
class LayerRecord(BaseModel):
    branch: str; pr: int; head: str; base: str; linked: bool
class StackMetadata(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="allow")
    trunk: str; stack_number: int | None; layers: list[LayerRecord]
class FamilyMetadata(BaseModel):          # sanity, qa, fix, finding and their children
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="allow")
    branch: str; worktree: str; pr_target: str; difficulty: Literal["hard", "normal", "fast"]
MODELS_BY_STAGE = {"stage:sprint": SprintBead, "stage:dev-sanity": SanityBead, "stage:qa": QaBead, "stage:fix": FixBead,
                   "stage:finding": FindingBead, "stage:gate": GateBead, "stage:stack": StackBead}
def validate_phase(beads: list[dict]) -> list[str]: ...   # "<bead>: <missing key>" per problem
```
`bead_schema.py validate --phase <x>` exit 0 valid, 5 problems listed, 2 cannot run.

## Exact Targets
- new `skills/atm-beads/templates/stack-bead.json.j2`
- edited `skills/atm-beads/scripts/bead_schema.py`, `validate-plan`, `phase-config`, `plan_contract.py`, `resources/planning.md`, `resources/orchestrating.md`, `schemas/*.schema.json`, `skills/atm-bd-orchestration/scripts/bead-groups`, `templates/dev-sanity-assignment.json.j2`, `templates/qa-bead.json.j2`, tests under both `scripts/tests`
- deleted `skills/atm-bd-orchestration/templates/dev-fix.xml.j2`, `examples/dev-fix-vars.json`
acceptance_criteria:
## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] (ANC-067) rendering `stack-bead.json.j2` with the phase-bj root vars gives id `atm-phase-bj.stack`, parent `atm-phase-bj`, `metadata.trunk` `integrate/phase-bj`, `layers` `[]`; `validate-plan --file <plan.jsonl> --phase bj --index docs/plans/phase-bj.jsonl` exits 5 naming the stack bead when it is left out of the file and 0 when it is present.
- [ ] (ANC-067) `StackMetadata` rejects a layer entry missing any of `branch`, `pr`, `head`, `base`, `linked`; the test fixture with two layers reads the top as `layers[-1]`.
- [ ] (ANC-063) `bead-groups --sprint <id>` in a scratch bd database: `bd show <id>.group-sanity --json` and `bd show <id>.group-qa --json` each carry `branch`, `worktree`, `pr_target` and `difficulty` equal to the container's; the fix group of a blocking finding carries the same four keys.
- [ ] (ANC-063) `bead_schema.py validate --phase <x>` over a phase with one sanity bead stripped of `branch` exits 5 with the line `<bead>: branch`; `bead-groups` on the same input exits non-zero and pours nothing new.
- [ ] (#340 item 5) tests with fixtures named `atm-bi-7`, `atm-bi-7.group-sanity`, `atm-phase-bi.15-sanity` and `atm-phase-bi.18-qa` pass.
- [ ] (task-close-hook.md 15) `rg -n "dev-fix|dev_fix" plugins --glob '!CHANGELOG.md'` matches only the compatibility reader of an existing phase file; `phase-config init` writes six template keys.
- [ ] `python3 skills/atm-beads/scripts/bead_schema.py export schemas` reproduces the committed schemas byte for byte.

## Validation
- `just lint` and `just test` in the atm-bd-orchestration worktree.
- `.claude/skills/atm-beads/scripts/validate-plan --ci` in atm-core after the skill install (every tracked phase file still parses without `dev_fix`).
